incoming_email.body:

My credit card on file keeps failing for this month's renewal of the Pro plan. I've verified with my bank and there are sufficient funds.

Mike

reference_response.subject: Re: Card declined but I have funds
reference_response.body:
Hi Mike,

Thanks for letting us know! We often see this when the bank's fraud detection blocks the charge temporarily.

Let us know if you need anything else.

Best,
Billing Team
